title: Course instance
description: An offering of a course at a particular time, location, or mode of study.

url.description: A detail page for this specific course offering.

name.description: An optional label for this offering, such as Summer semester 2026.

inLanguage.description: The language or languages in which learners can participate in this specific course offering.

maximumAttendeeCapacity.description: The maximum number of attendees who can participate in this offering; zero means no limit.

remainingAttendeeCapacity.description: The number of attendee places for this offering that remain unallocated; zero means no places remain available.

startDate.description: The RFC 3339 date-time at which the course offering starts.

endDate.description: The RFC 3339 date-time at which the course offering ends.

duration.description: The ISO 8601 duration of the course offering, for example P3M.
